steps.why: An Ogg stream is set up and cleared; Vorbis's encoder takes a stereo 48 kHz setup.

steps.script: printf '%s\n' '#include <ogg/ogg.h>' 'int main(void) { ogg_stream_state stream; return ogg_stream_init(&stream, 7) != 0 || ogg_stream_clear(&stream) != 0; }' > /tmp/amy-ogg.c && cc -O0 /tmp/amy-ogg.c -logg -o /tmp/amy-ogg && /tmp/amy-ogg

printf '%s\n' '#include <vorbis/vorbisenc.h>' '#include <string.h>' 'int main(void) { vorbis_info info; vorbis_info_init(&info); int failed = vorbis_encode_init_vbr(&info, 2, 48000, .4f) != 0 || strncmp(vorbis_version_string(), "Xiph", 4) != 0; vorbis_info_clear(&info); return failed; }' > /tmp/amy-vorbis.c && cc -O0 /tmp/amy-vorbis.c -lvorbisenc -lvorbis -logg -lm -o /tmp/amy-vorbis && /tmp/amy-vorbis
